claim: Historical batter recognition behavior contains future predictive information beyond measured opportunity characteristics.
metric: Delta log loss, Brier, ROC AUC
allowed_wording: Historical batter recognition behavior contains information about future recognition beyond measured opportunity characteristics.
prohibited_overstated_wording: Batter identity proves innate recognition skill.

claim: Some batters show different observed recognition behavior.
allowed_wording: Some batters appear to recognize eligible misses more often than others in this snapshot.

claim: Batter differences remain after opportunity adjustment.
allowed_wording: Differences remain after controlling for accepted geometry and situation variables.

population: Batters supported in both ordered halves
allowed_wording: Adjusted recognition differences show moderate season-to-date stability.

claim: Raw challenge rate is not adjusted recognition.
allowed_wording: Opportunity adjustment changes some batter standings.
prohibited_overstated_wording: Raw challenge rate measures recognition skill.

claim: An adjusted leaderboard is sufficiently supported for publication validation.
limitations: Ranks with overlapping intervals are not meaningfully distinct
allowed_wording: The evidence supports taking an adjusted leaderboard to publication validation.
prohibited_overstated_wording: Each adjacent numeric rank is meaningfully different.

limitations: Identity effects and repeatability do not establish mechanism
allowed_wording: Observed recognition behavior has a repeatable batter-specific component.
prohibited_overstated_wording: Recognition is proven to be an innate skill.

allowed_wording: Recognition differences were moderately repeatable within the observed season.
prohibited_overstated_wording: Recognition is persistent or a permanent player trait.

claim: Batter recognition differences are caused by vision, experience, approach, coaching, confidence, or cognitive ability.
allowed_wording: The analysis does not identify why batter differences exist.
prohibited_overstated_wording: Vision or experience causes the measured effect.
